subject: Regarding changes in interval of detection probability graphs (perpendicular distance)

messages.author: 274786ec2f7eed2e
messages.subject: Regarding changes in interval of detection probability graphs (perpendicular distance)
parts:
Dear all,
I am perusing PhD on marine mammals. During the survey of marine mammals i got perpendicular distance and i analysed in distance software. the default setting of the software showing 120 meter interval in detection probability graph. i want to change this interval in 100 meter. i tried but i could not get so you are requested to please help me for the same.

Thanking you

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Regarding changes in interval of detection probability graphs (perpendicular distance)
parts:
Yash

When plotting the fitted detection function, you can specify the number of breaks in the histogram underlying the detection function.  Perhaps that will give you the result you desire.  Try this code with the example data set:

library(Distance)
data("minke")
simple <- ds(minke, key="hr", truncation=1.5)
plot(simple)
plot(simple, breaks=seq(0,1.5,length=15))
plot(simple, breaks=seq(0,1.5,length=20))
plot(simple, breaks=seq(0,1.5,length=25))
